summary: To upgrade the Ansible plug-ins on a Helm install with OCI delivery, change the version tag (such as `automation-portal:2.1`) in each `package` URL under `global.dynamic.plugins` and click Upgrade; the RHDH pods restart and pull the new version.
questions: How do I upgrade the Ansible RHDH plug-ins with OCI delivery?
Where is the plug-in version tag in the Helm chart?
